mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as envContractorName, c2.C_Name as enbContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as envContrAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as enbContrAbbName, enis.Enis_Project_Name as enisProjectName, enis.Enis_Name as enisName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_En_Verify mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Env_Contractor_Id=c1.C_Id left join Con_En_Budget enb on mn.Enb_Id=enb.Enb_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on enb.Enb_Contractor_Id=c2.C_Id left join Con_Enis enis on enis.Enis_Id=mn.Enis_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Env_Id where mn.Env_Id=#{envId}
